title: Laws of refraction: refractive index
notes: **Scope.** Laws of refraction: refractive index — Refraction at Plane Surfaces, Physics (class-11-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: laws of refraction: refractive index · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** Lens maker: 1/f = (μ − 1)(1/R₁ − 1/R₂). Power P = 1/f (dioptre, f in metres); lenses add powers in contact.
**Fact.** Refraction at a plane surface (Snell): n₁ sinθ₁ = n₂ sinθ₂. Total internal reflection when θ > θ_c, sinθ_c = n₂/n₁ (n₂<n₁).
**Fact.** Prism minimum deviation: n = sin((A + D_min)/2)/sin(A/2). Achromatic doublet pairs crown (low Abbe) + flint (high Abbe).
